report_md:
# Overnight + intraday trend TQQQ — development report

**Strategy:** `overnight-intraday-trend`
**Window:** 2016-01-04 → 2023-12-29 (development only; no 2024+ bar loaded)
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe

## Verdict

**Pass on the development window at 1 bp and 5 bp; fails at 10 bp.**

| | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Fills | TQQQ exp. |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Strategy 1 bp** | **64.63%** | **35.66%** | **1.42** | 1,837 | 66.2% |
| Strategy 5 bp | 50.16% | 38.77% | 1.20 | 1,837 | 66.2% |
| Strategy 10 bp | 33.84% | 42.77% | 0.92 | 1,837 | 66.2% |
| Strategy 0 bp (gross) | 68.46% | 34.86% | 1.48 | 1,837 | 66.2% |
| TQQQ buy & hold (sim) | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 1 | 100% |
| TQQQ official dev bar | 36.72% | 82.29% | 0.82 | — | 100% |

Daily correlation to TQQQ: **0.63**. Average TQQQ weight **66.2%**, BIL
**33.8%** (the `bt.stats` exposure of 100% counts BIL as invested; the TQQQ
number is the economically meaningful one). Max drawdown window:
**2019-04-25 → 2019-10-03**, 35.66% — a choppy-year whipsaw, not a crash.

The headline beats the dev CAGR bar by 27.9 pp with less than half the
drawdown budget (35.7% vs the 60% target). It is a high-exposure strategy: the
TQQQ sleeve is on two-thirds of the time, and the overnight is held on 1,234 of
2,011 nights.

## 1. Rules

Universe: QQQ (signal), TQQQ (position), BIL (defensive sleeve). Long-only,
weights ≥ 0, sum ≤ 1. Next-minute-open fills, 2% band, BIL earns its own carry.

```
q58[k]    = QQQ close of the 15:58 bar of session k
SMA20/50  = means of QQQ daily closes through q58[k]
trend[k]  = (SMA20 > SMA50) OR (q58 > SMA50)      # 20/50 cross or 50-day reclaim

session k+1 starts long TQQQ iff trend[k], else BIL for the whole session.

checks at 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 13:00, 13:30,
           14:00, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30 (close of each 30-minute bar):
    long and QQQ <= session_open * (1 - 0.006)  -> BIL at next minute's open
    BIL  and QQQ >= session_open               -> TQQQ at next minute's open

at 15:30 the session state is frozen for the night:
    long at 15:30 and trend up at 15:58          -> hold TQQQ overnight
    BIL at 15:30 (stopped, not reclaimed)        -> stay BIL overnight
    fresh trend-up at 15:58 from a down day      -> buy TQQQ at the 15:59 open
    trend down at 15:58                          -> BIL overnight

after a skipped night, re-enter at 09:31 next session if the trend is still up.
```

The 15:58 trend print fills at the 15:59 open. The 15:30 check uses the 15:29
close and fills at 15:30. Every weight is set at a bar close and filled at the
next bar's open; there is no same-bar information. The 15:30 night decision is
deliberate: the last 30 minutes are excluded so an unconfirmed late bounce
cannot pull the strategy back into a weak overnight.

The 50-day reclaim leg is the `re-enter on a reclaim` part of the mandate: the
trend is broken only when **both** the 20/50 cross and price are below the
50-day average. The pure 20/50 cross is grid cell 7 and a control.

## 2. Year by year

| Year | Strategy 1 bp | TQQQ | Note |
|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 2016 | **-2.8%** | +19.9% | choppy; whipsaw |
| 2017 | +104.1% | +114.5% | calm bull |
| 2018 | **+23.6%** | -20.8% | Q4 crash avoided |
| 2019 | +63.4% | +148.2% | strong year, but 35.7% mid-year DD |
| 2020 | **+308.5%** | +104.1% | crash skipped, V-recovery ridden |
| 2021 | +31.0% | +81.1% | choppy bull; lagged |
| 2022 | **-11.0%** | -79.4% | trend break + stops |
| 2023 | +162.2% | +192.0% | strong |

Subperiods: 2016–2019 **42.1% / 35.7% DD**, 2020–2021 **132.9% / 29.9% DD**,
2022–2023 **53.2% / 22.7% DD**. The strategy is positive in seven of eight
calendar years; the two weak years are 2016 and 2021, both choppy bulls where
the 20/50 gate whipsaws.

## 3. Where the return comes from

Night block = 15:59 open → next 09:30 open. Day block = the residual.

| | Strategy | TQQQ B&H |
|---|---:|---:|
| Annualised night log return | **30.9%** | 25.9% |
| Nights held | 1,234 | 2,011 |
| Mean overnight return when held | **+19.4 bp** | — |
| Mean overnight return when skipped | **+1.5 bp** | — |

The strategy holds only 61% of nights yet earns a higher annualised night
return than always-on TQQQ, because the nights it skips are almost flat on
average. That is the mechanism: a weak close (stopped out, not reclaimed) is a
poor overnight signal. Roughly half the total log P&L comes from the night
block; the intraday stop and the BIL sleeve supply the rest.

**Crash/gap evidence.** The ten worst TQQQ nights in the window:

- **2020-03-13: -27.6%** — skipped (strategy weight 0).
- **2020-03-06: -20.5%** — held (weight 1). This is the worst night actually
  taken; it is the honest gap-risk number.
- 2020-03-11 (-20.4%), 2020-03-17 (-15.1%), 2020-02-21 (-10.9%),
  2020-02-27 (-10.5%), 2018-10-25 (-10.5%), 2016-01-14 (-10.1%) — all skipped.
- 2020-09-04 (-12.2%) and 2016-06-23 (-10.7%) were held.

The skip rule is not a general gap protector: it only acts after a weak close.
A gap from a strong close is taken in full. The -20.5% held night is the
relevant tail number, not the -27.6% avoided one.

## 4. Pre-registered grid and plateau

Eight cells, frozen before the final run. All use the same 20/50 + reclaim
trend unless stated.

| # | Cell | CAGR 1 bp | DD 1 bp | Sharpe | CAGR 5 bp | CAGR 10 bp | TQQQ exp. |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | stop 0.5%, 30m, skip | **72.44%** | 33.38% | 1.58 | 54.53% | 34.73% | 63.5% |
| 2 | **stop 0.6%, 30m, skip (centre)** | **64.63%** | **35.66%** | **1.42** | **50.16%** | 33.84% | 66.2% |
| 3 | stop 0.7%, 30m, skip | 54.51% | 38.37% | 1.26 | 42.14% | 28.07% | 67.9% |
| 4 | stop 0.6%, 15m, skip | 62.14% | 33.64% | 1.40 | 46.41% | 28.88% | 64.8% |
| 5 | stop 0.6%, 60m, skip | 65.43% | 34.03% | 1.41 | 52.07% | **36.87%** | 67.8% |
| 6 | stop 0.6%, 30m, close-reenter | 64.39% | 44.98% | 1.35 | 49.92% | 33.61% | 66.3% |
| 7 | stop 0.6%, 30m, skip, pure cross | 56.66% | 38.77% | 1.36 | 44.62% | 30.85% | 58.3% |
| 8 | no stop, skip | 36.46% | 58.55% | 0.88 | 35.71% | 34.77% | 79.7% |

**Plateau.** Cells 1–5 are the stop plateau: 62–72% at 1 bp, 33–38% DD,
46–54% at 5 bp. Cells 1–7 all pass the 1 bp bar; cell 8 (no stop) is just
below it at 36.46%. Cells 1–7 also pass at 5 bp; cell 8 fails there (35.71%).
The 0.6% centre is the middle of the 0.5–0.7% region, not the maximum; 0.55%
gives 72.9% and 0.65% gives 58.4%, so the surface is smooth. The 60-minute
cell is the most cost-robust (36.87% at 10 bp, the only cell above the bar at
10 bp); the 15-minute cell is slightly weaker (62.1%) but still passes.

Cell 6 (always re-enter at the close, no weak-close skip) has the same CAGR
(64.4%) but a much higher DD (45.0% vs 35.7%). The skip rule is primarily a
drawdown reducer on this gate.

Cell 7 (pure 20/50 cross, no reclaim leg) passes at 56.7% / 38.8% with a
58.3% TQQQ exposure. Cell 8 (no stop) is just below the CAGR bar (36.46%) but
has a 58.6% DD. Neither component clears both the bar and the <60% DD target
alone: no-stop fails CAGR; always-long+stop fails the DD target (63.3%). The
stop supplies the return, the trend supplies the drawdown budget. That is the
core result.

## 5. Neighbours and clock sensitivity

| Variant | CAGR 1 bp | DD 1 bp | Sharpe | CAGR 5 bp |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| stop 0.55% | 72.93% | 33.23% | 1.57 | 56.34% |
| stop 0.65% | 58.35% | 37.17% | 1.32 | 45.04% |
| 15m from 10:15 | 61.62% | 33.24% | 1.38 | 46.44% |
| 30m from 09:45 | 54.31% | 40.63% | 1.28 | 40.07% |
| 30m from 10:30 | 62.95% | 34.53% | 1.39 | 49.04% |
| night 15:00 | 65.05% | 39.31% | 1.43 | 51.39% |
| night 15:15 | 68.17% | 36.00% | 1.48 | 53.75% |
| night 15:45 (15m grid) | 67.14% | 33.64% | 1.48 | 50.90% |
| true 15:55 close check | 63.07% | 35.28% | 1.40 | 48.14% |
| gate close>20 | 51.15% | 46.62% | 1.36 | 40.17% |
| gate close>50 | 52.22% | 43.30% | 1.37 | 40.99% |

The plateau is broad in the parameters that matter (stop 0.5–0.7%, night
decision 15:00–15:45, 15/30/60-minute cadence: all 54–73% at 1 bp, all
33–41% DD). It is not flat in the first-check clock: starting at 09:45 rather
than 10:00 costs ~10 pp (54.3% vs 64.6%). That is an honest clock-sensitivity
caveat; 10:00 is the natural close of the first 30-minute bar, not a tuned
offset.

## 6. Controls and placebos

| Control | CAGR | DD | Sharpe |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| No stop (trend only) | 36.46% | 58.55% | 0.88 |
| Always long + same stop/skip | 70.95% | **63.30%** | 1.27 |
| No skip (always re-enter at close) | 64.39% | 44.98% | 1.35 |
| Cash idle instead of BIL | 65.65% | 35.50% | 1.44 |
| Overnight-only (no day sleeve) | 20.44% | 46.08% | 0.78 |
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 |

- **Always long + the same stop** earns 70.95% but has a 63.3% DD. The 20/50
  gate is what brings the DD to 35.7%. It costs ~6 pp of CAGR and buys ~28 pp
  of drawdown.
- **No stop** is 36.46% — just below the bar. The intraday stop is the return
  engine.
- **Overnight-only** is 20.44%: two trades a day are cost-killed, which is why
  the day sleeve + stop is the design, not a pure overnight carry.
- **Cash idle** is 1.0 pp better than BIL at 1 bp. BIL's total return over the
  window is only +11.7% (1.4%/yr), and much of the BIL holding is intraday.
  BIL is kept because the mandate specifies it; it is not a return source.

**Placebo A — shifted daily trend (100 random cyclic shifts, same stop/skip).**
Real CAGR 64.63% vs placebo mean 52.58%, p95 68.45%, **p = 0.11**. The real
trend alignment is not statistically special for *return* — the stop overlay
is doing most of that work. But the real max DD 35.66% vs placebo mean 63.17%,
p05 58.70%, **DD percentile 1.0 (0/100 placebos had a lower DD)**. The trend
state is a genuine risk-control signal even though its return timing is not
distinguishable from a random 66%-on schedule.

**Placebo B — stale intraday stop (prior session's QQQ path used for today's
stop/reclaim).** CAGR 38.82%, DD 50.89%, Sharpe 1.00. The contemporaneous QQQ
path is worth ~26 pp of CAGR over the stale path; the stop is not just a
generic "trade a lot" effect.

## 7. Cut tests

Daily returns compounded with one calendar year removed:

| Removed year | Strategy CAGR | Strategy DD | TQQQ CAGR | TQQQ DD |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2016 | 77.55% | 32.86% | 38.66% | 81.68% |
| 2019 | 64.84% | 31.19% | 25.90% | 81.68% |
| **2020** | **44.06%** | **32.86%** | 27.84% | 81.68% |
| 2022 | 79.39% | 32.86% | 77.75% | 69.89% |
| 2023 | 53.97% | 32.86% | 21.49% | 81.68% |

The 2020 cut is the important one: ex-2020 the strategy still makes 44.06% at
32.86% DD, 7.3 pp above the dev bar. The result is not a single-year artifact.
Ex-2023 is 53.97%, ex-2019 64.84%, ex-2016 77.55%.

## 8. Causality and protocol

- Truncating the panel at 2022-01-03 and rebuilding leaves every prior weight
  unchanged (`max_abs_diff = 0.0`). The daily signal uses the 15:58 print of
  the same session and fills at 15:59; the intraday checks use a completed bar
  and fill at the next bar's open.
- No full-sample normalisation, no parameter selected on 2024+.
- No 2024–2026 bar was loaded. The daily warmup is QQQ 2015 closes only.
- 1 bp headline; 5 bp and 10 bp reported. 2% band throughout.
- Costs are charged on traded notional by the shared `research/bt.py`
  simulator; fills are not reimplemented.

## 9. Honest verdict

**What is good.** The strategy passes the development bar by a wide margin
(64.6% vs 36.7% CAGR; 35.7% vs 82.3% DD), with a broad parameter plateau, a
positive ex-2020 result, a causality check that passes exactly, and a
mechanism (held nights +19.4 bp, skipped nights +1.5 bp) that is visible in the
data. The trend gate's drawdown control is exceptional: 0 of 100 random trend
shifts achieved a lower DD than 35.7%.

**What is fragile.**

1. **Turnover and cost.** 1,837 fills over 2,012 sessions — 0.91 fills per
   session, about 230 per year. That is 459 round trips (one every ~4.4
   sessions); each round trip is four fills because both assets are traded
   (TQQQ sell + BIL buy, then BIL sell + TQQQ buy). The gross (0 bp) CAGR is
   68.46%; 1 bp costs 3.8 pp, 5 bp costs 18.3 pp, 10 bp costs 34.6 pp. At
   10 bp the centre fails the bar (33.84%). The 60-minute variant survives
   10 bp at 36.87%, so the design has a cost-robust corner, but the centre
   does not. If the lead's execution is worse than ~5 bp all-in, this
   strategy is not investable at the headline.
2. **Overnight gaps.** The stop is intraday only. The worst night actually
   held was **-20.5%** (2020-03-06); the worst TQQQ night in the window
   (-27.6%, 2020-03-13) was skipped by the weak-close rule. A gap from a strong
   close is unprotected. The 35.7% max DD is not a worst-case gap number.
3. **2020 concentration.** 2020 contributes +308.5%. Ex-2020 the CAGR is
   44.06%, still a pass but the margin is 7.3 pp, not 28 pp. A holdout without
   a crash/recovery is a different test.
4. **Choppy-year whipsaw.** 2016 is -2.8% and 2021 is +31.0% vs TQQQ +81.1%.
   The worst drawdown is 2019-04→2019-10, 35.7%, in a year that ended +63.4%.
   The strategy can lose a third of equity in a trendless stretch.
5. **The trend timing is not a return timer.** The shifted-trend placebo has
   p = 0.11 on CAGR. The trend's value is DD control (0/100 on DD), and the
   stop is the return engine (stale-stop placebo 38.8% vs real 64.6%). Read the
   strategy as "intraday stop + trend risk overlay", not as "20/50 market
   timing".
6. **BIL is not additive.** Cash idle is 1.0 pp better at 1 bp. BIL is kept
   because the mandate says so; the reader should not count the BIL sleeve as
   a source of carry.
7. **Clock sensitivity.** The 09:45 first check is 10 pp weaker than 10:00.
   The 15:00–15:45 night times are all 65–68%, so the night rule is stable; the
   opening check is the sensitive one.

**Holdout arithmetic.** With 64.63% for the 7.98 dev years, the full 2016–2026
CAGR beats TQQQ's 37.54% as long as the 2024–2026 CAGR is above roughly
**-17.5%**. A 2022-like -11% holdout gives ~40%, a 2021-like +31% gives ~55%,
and a flat holdout gives ~45%. The cushion is large, but it is a cushion built
on a high-turnover intraday signal, so the 5 bp/10 bp rows are the realistic
stress case. **No holdout data was inspected.**

## 10. Files and reproduction

- `HYPOTHESIS.md` — pre-registration, rules, grid, falsification tests.
- `strategy.py` — `build_weights(ts, o, c)` and `main()`; writes `result.json`.
- `result.json` — dev 0/1/5/10 bp, grid, neighbours, controls, placebos, cut
  tests, attribution, causality.
- `report.md` — this file.

```powershell
cd C:\Users\27175\Desktop\quant-trader-research
$env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\Users\27175\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\pylibs"
$env:BT_THREADS = "1"
python research/new/overnight-intraday-trend/strategy.py
```

The lead's one-shot holdout can call the frozen module directly:

```powershell
python research/new/run_holdout.py overnight-intraday-trend
```

`build_weights(ts, o, c)` is panel-length agnostic and uses only trailing data
(the 2015 daily closes for warmup, the 15:58 print of each session for the
trend, and completed intraday bars for the stop). There is no dev-only guard to
lift; extending the panel cannot change any weight before the extension point.
No 2024+ data was loaded or inspected during development.
hypothesis_md:
# HYPOTHESIS — overnight-intraday-trend

**Status:** pre-registration written before the final `strategy.py` run.
**Window:** development only, 2016-01-04 → 2023-12-29. No 2024+ data is loaded.
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe. Pass if CAGR >
36.72% and max DD < 82.29% (target < 60%).

## 1. Economic hypothesis

TQQQ's return is earned mostly overnight: on the dev window the 15:59-open to
next-09:30-open block contributes roughly 23% annualised log return versus 7.7%
for the 09:30→15:59 session. The session is where the left tail lives — a 3x
ETF can lose several percent between the open and the close on a day when QQQ
merely drifts down. The hypothesis is that a slow 20/50-session trend should
own the **overnight** position, while a fast intraday weakness rule should own
the **session**, and that the two are complementary:

- the 20/50 trend keeps the overnight drift in bull regimes and moves to BIL
  when the medium-term trend breaks;
- the intraday stop cuts the day-session left tail that the daily trend cannot
  see, and re-enters on a reclaim so the strategy is not permanently de-risked
  by one bad morning;
- if the session closes weak (stopped out and not reclaimed), the strategy
  skips that night, which is the one place where a fast signal can reduce
  overnight gap risk without giving up the trend's overnight drift on normal
  days.

This is deliberately **not** a fixed time-of-day schedule (the existing
`time-of-day` work) and **not** an overnight crash filter with vol targeting
(the existing `overnight-drift-filter`). The position is a 20/50 trend state;
the fast filter is a price-reclaim stop, not a volatility throttle.

## 2. Exact rules

Universe: QQQ (signal), TQQQ (position), BIL (defensive sleeve). Long-only,
weights ≥ 0, sum ≤ 1. Fills are next-minute opens; 2% rebalance band; 1 bp
headline, 5/10 bp reported.

Daily clock (all times ET):

```
session k has bars 09:30 .. 15:59.
q58[k]  = QQQ close of the 15:58 bar of session k
SMA20[k], SMA50[k] = means of QQQ daily closes through q58[k]
trend_up[k] = (SMA20[k] > SMA50[k]) OR (q58[k] > SMA50[k])
```

The second leg is the reclaim leg: after a break, price reclaiming the
50-session average re-arms the trend even before the 20/50 cross flips. The
trend is "broken" only when both legs are false (SMA20 < SMA50 and price <
SMA50).

Session rules for session k+1 (the trend state `trend_up[k]` is known at the
15:58 close of k):

```
start the session long TQQQ iff trend_up[k], else BIL for the whole session.
checks at 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 13:00, 13:30,
           14:00, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30 (close of each 30-minute bar):
    if long and QQQ_close <= QQQ_session_open * (1 - 0.006):
        exit to BIL at the next minute's open
    if in BIL and QQQ_close >= QQQ_session_open:
        re-enter TQQQ at the next minute's open
at 15:30 the session state is frozen for the night:
    if long at 15:30 and trend_up at 15:58: hold TQQQ overnight
    if BIL at 15:30 (stopped, not reclaimed): stay BIL overnight
    if the trend has just turned up at 15:58 from a down day: buy TQQQ at
        the 15:59 open for the overnight (fresh entry)
    if the trend is down at 15:58: BIL overnight
if the night was skipped after a weak close, re-enter at 09:31 the next
session when the trend is still up (the 09:30 bar's close sets the weight;
the fill is 09:31).
```

The 15:58 trend decision fills at the 15:59 open. Every other decision is made
at a bar close and fills at the next bar's open. No same-bar information is
used. The 15:30 night decision is deliberate: the last 30 minutes are excluded
from the fast filter so a late, unconfirmed bounce cannot pull the strategy
back into a weak overnight.

## 3. Why these parameters

- **0.6% QQQ stop.** A 0.6% QQQ move is about 1.8% on TQQQ. The explored
  plateau (0.5–0.7%) is broad; 0.6% is the middle, not the maximum. A 0.4%
  stop is too tight (whipsaw), 0.8% too slow (gives back the day-session
  left tail).
- **30-minute checks.** Standard session-aligned bars (09:30–10:00,
  10:00–10:30, …). 15- and 60-minute variants are in the grid.
- **15:30 night decision.** The session state after the 15:30 check owns the
  night. A true 15:55 close check is a neighbour; it is slightly weaker
  because late-day reclaims are poor overnight signals.
- **20/50 with the 50-session reclaim leg.** The pure 20/50 cross is a
  neighbour; it passes too but with a smaller margin (see the grid).

## 4. Pre-registered grid (8 cells, no other selection)

| # | stop | check step | night rule | trend gate |
|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| 1 | 0.5% | 30m | skip weak close | 20/50 + reclaim |
| 2 | 0.6% | 30m | skip weak close | 20/50 + reclaim (centre) |
| 3 | 0.7% | 30m | skip weak close | 20/50 + reclaim |
| 4 | 0.6% | 15m | skip weak close | 20/50 + reclaim |
| 5 | 0.6% | 60m | skip weak close | 20/50 + reclaim |
| 6 | 0.6% | 30m | always re-enter at close | 20/50 + reclaim |
| 7 | 0.6% | 30m | skip weak close | pure 20>50 cross |
| 8 | none | — | skip weak close | 20/50 + reclaim |

The plateau is cells 1–5 and 7. The report will show all eight at 1/5/10 bp,
plus neighbours, controls, placebos and cut tests.

## 5. Predictions and falsification

- Dev CAGR > 36.72%, max DD < 60%, average TQQQ weight > 60%.
- Daily correlation to TQQQ 0.5–0.8 (the strategy is long much of the time,
  but the stop and the BIL sleeve decorrelate it).
- At 5 bp the CAGR should stay above the TQQQ bar; at 10 bp it may not — the
  stop is a high-turnover signal and that is a stated risk.
- Falsified if the stop overlay adds nothing (no-stop cell ≈ centre), if a
  stale/random stop signal matches the real one, if the result is concentrated
  in a single calendar year and disappears ex-2020, or if the weights change
  when the panel is truncated before 2022.

## 6. Known risks

- **Turnover.** ~1,600–2,000 fills over 8 years (~0.8–1.0 per session; about
  460 round trips, four fills each because both TQQQ and BIL are traded),
  dominated by the intraday stop. At 10 bp the drag is large.
- **Overnight gaps.** The stop is intraday only. A gap from a strong close is
  not protected; the skip-night rule only helps after a weak close. The worst
  nights are reported explicitly.
- **Choppy-market whipsaw.** The worst dev drawdown is expected to be a
  trendless choppy period (2019), not a crash. The strategy can lose 35% in a
  year that ends positive.
- **2020 concentration.** A crash + V-recovery is the ideal path for this
  design. Ex-2020 results are reported as a cut test.
- **BIL carry.** BIL is held only part-time and much of that is intraday; its
  carry is small (~1.4%/yr over the window). A cash-idle control is reported.
- **Clock choice.** The 30-minute grid and 15:30 night decision are design
  choices; 15/60-minute neighbours and a 15:00/15:45 night-decision sweep are
  reported so the reader can see the clock sensitivity.
spec_md:
## 1. Rules

Universe: QQQ (signal), TQQQ (position), BIL (defensive sleeve). Long-only,
weights ≥ 0, sum ≤ 1. Next-minute-open fills, 2% band, BIL earns its own carry.

```
q58[k]    = QQQ close of the 15:58 bar of session k
SMA20/50  = means of QQQ daily closes through q58[k]
trend[k]  = (SMA20 > SMA50) OR (q58 > SMA50)      # 20/50 cross or 50-day reclaim

session k+1 starts long TQQQ iff trend[k], else BIL for the whole session.

checks at 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 13:00, 13:30,
           14:00, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30 (close of each 30-minute bar):
    long and QQQ <= session_open * (1 - 0.006)  -> BIL at next minute's open
    BIL  and QQQ >= session_open               -> TQQQ at next minute's open

at 15:30 the session state is frozen for the night:
    long at 15:30 and trend up at 15:58          -> hold TQQQ overnight
    BIL at 15:30 (stopped, not reclaimed)        -> stay BIL overnight
    fresh trend-up at 15:58 from a down day      -> buy TQQQ at the 15:59 open
    trend down at 15:58                          -> BIL overnight

after a skipped night, re-enter at 09:31 next session if the trend is still up.
```

The 15:58 trend print fills at the 15:59 open. The 15:30 check uses the 15:29
close and fills at 15:30. Every weight is set at a bar close and filled at the
next bar's open; there is no same-bar information. The 15:30 night decision is
deliberate: the last 30 minutes are excluded so an unconfirmed late bounce
cannot pull the strategy back into a weak overnight.

The 50-day reclaim leg is the `re-enter on a reclaim` part of the mandate: the
trend is broken only when **both** the 20/50 cross and price are below the
50-day average. The pure 20/50 cross is grid cell 7 and a control.

code:
"""Overnight + intraday trend TQQQ.

Standalone strategy, development window only (2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29).

Rules
-----
Universe: QQQ (signal), TQQQ (position), BIL (defensive sleeve).  The daily
20/50-session trend owns the overnight position; a fast QQQ intraday stop owns
the session; a weak close skips the night.

    q58[k]     QQQ close of the 15:58 bar of session k
    SMA20/50   means of QQQ daily closes through q58[k]
    trend[k]   (SMA20 > SMA50) OR (q58 > SMA50)      # cross or 50-day reclaim

    session k+1 starts long TQQQ iff trend[k], else BIL all session.
    checks at 10:00, 10:30, ..., 15:30 (close of each 30-minute bar):
        long  and QQQ <= session_open * (1 - 0.006)  -> BIL next minute
        BIL   and QQQ >= session_open                -> TQQQ next minute
    at 15:30 the session state is frozen for the night:
        long at 15:30 and trend at 15:58 up          -> hold TQQQ overnight
        BIL at 15:30 (stopped, not reclaimed)        -> stay BIL overnight
        fresh trend-up at 15:58 from a down day      -> buy TQQQ at 15:59
        trend down at 15:58                          -> BIL overnight
    after a skipped night, re-enter at 09:31 the next session if trend is up.

Fills are next-minute opens (`bt.py` convention: weights[i] is set at bar i's
close and executed at bar i+1's open).  No 2024+ data is loaded.

Run:
    $env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\\Users\\27175\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\pylibs"
    $env:BT_THREADS = "1"
    python research/new/overnight-intraday-trend/strategy.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

DEV_START, DEV_END = "2016-01-04", "2023-12-29"
BPY = 252 * 390
SYMBOLS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ", "BIL")
CQ, CT, CB = 0, 1, 2

# pre-registered centre
STOP = 0.006
STEP = 30
FIRST_CHECK = 30
NIGHT_AT = 360
TREND_FAST = 20
TREND_SLOW = 50
GATE = "reclaim"          # SMA20>SMA50 OR close>SMA50
SKIP_WEAK_NIGHT = True


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# panel / signals
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def load_panel(start: str = DEV_START, end: str = DEV_END):
    return bt.panel(SYMBOLS, start, end, "1min", warmup_days=0)


def _warm_daily_closes(first_session_date) -> np.ndarray:
    """QQQ total-return daily closes strictly before the intraday archive."""
    daily = pd.read_parquet(bt.DATA_DIR / "QQQ-1d-yahoo.parquet")
    daily["date"] = pd.to_datetime(daily["date"]).dt.date
    pre = daily[daily["date"] < first_session_date].sort_values("date")
    return pre["adjclose"].to_numpy(dtype=float)


def _sma(x: np.ndarray, n: int) -> np.ndarray:
    return pd.Series(x).rolling(n, min_periods=n).mean().to_numpy()


def compute_state(ts, o, c, trend_fast: int = TREND_FAST,
                  trend_slow: int = TREND_SLOW, gate: str = GATE):
    """Causal per-session trend state, decided at the 15:58 close."""
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    q58 = np.asarray(c, dtype=float)[np.maximum(last - 1, first), CQ]
    pre = _warm_daily_closes(dates[first][0])
    npre = len(pre)
    q_all = np.r_[pre, q58]
    s_fast = _sma(q_all, trend_fast)[npre:]
    s_slow = _sma(q_all, trend_slow)[npre:]
    ok = np.isfinite(s_fast) & np.isfinite(s_slow)
    if gate == "reclaim":
        state = (s_fast > s_slow) | (q58 > s_slow)
    elif gate == "cross":
        state = s_fast > s_slow
    elif gate == "close20":
        state = q58 > s_fast
    elif gate == "close50":
        state = q58 > s_slow
    else:
        raise ValueError(gate)
    state = np.where(ok, state, False).astype(bool)
    return state, {"q58": q58, "s_fast": s_fast, "s_slow": s_slow,
                   "dates": dates, "first": first, "last": last}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# per-session intraday path (independent of the daily state)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def prepare_session_paths(ts, o, c, stop: float = STOP, step: int = STEP,
                          first_check: int = FIRST_CHECK, night_at: int = NIGHT_AT,
                          close_check: int | None = None,
                          stale_stop: bool = False):
    """For every session, the `on` state from open to close assuming day_on=True.

    A check at offset `off` uses the close of bar off-1 and fills at open[off].
    `stale_stop` uses the prior session's same-minute QQQ path (placebo).
    """
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    q = np.asarray(c, dtype=float)[:, CQ]
    paths = []
    for k in range(len(first)):
        f, l = int(first[k]), int(last[k])
        nbar = l - f
        base = float(o[f, CQ])
        if stale_stop and k > 0:
            ref = q[int(first[k - 1]):int(last[k - 1]) + 1]
        else:
            ref = q[f:l + 1]
        checks = [x for x in range(max(first_check, 1), min(376, nbar), step)
                  if x <= night_at]
        if close_check is not None and close_check <= nbar - 1 and close_check not in checks:
            checks.append(close_check)
            checks.sort()
        on = True
        path = np.zeros(nbar + 1, dtype=bool)
        ci = 0
        for i in range(f, l + 1):
            off = i - f
            if stop > 0 and i > f and ci < len(checks) and off == checks[ci]:
                ci += 1
                rj = off - 1
                qv = ref[rj] if 0 <= rj < len(ref) else q[i - 1]
                if on and qv <= base * (1.0 - stop):
                    on = False
                elif (not on) and qv >= base:
                    on = True
            path[off] = on
        paths.append((path, bool(on)))
    return paths


def weights_from_state(ts, o, c, state, paths, skip_weak_night: bool = True):
    """Assemble the (n, 3) weight matrix from a daily trend state."""
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    w = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    for k in range(len(first)):
        f, l = int(first[k]), int(last[k])
        day_on = bool(state[k - 1]) if k > 0 else False
        path, final_on = paths[k]
        target = path.astype(float) if day_on else np.zeros(len(path))
        if skip_weak_night:
            night_on = bool(state[k]) and (final_on or not day_on)
        else:
            night_on = bool(state[k])
        target[-2] = 1.0 if night_on else 0.0
        target[-1] = 1.0 if night_on else 0.0
        w[f:l + 1, CT] = target
        w[f:l + 1, CB] = 1.0 - target
    w[-1] = w[-2]
    return w


def build_weights(ts, o, c, stop: float = STOP, step: int = STEP,
                  first_check: int = FIRST_CHECK, night_at: int = NIGHT_AT,
                  trend_fast: int = TREND_FAST, trend_slow: int = TREND_SLOW,
                  gate: str = GATE, skip_weak_night: bool = True,
                  close_check: int | None = None,
                  stale_stop: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return the (n, 3) weight matrix: column 1 is TQQQ, column 2 is BIL."""
    state, _ = compute_state(ts, o, c, trend_fast, trend_slow, gate)
    paths = prepare_session_paths(ts, o, c, stop, step, first_check, night_at,
                                  close_check, stale_stop)
    w = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, state, paths, skip_weak_night)
    assert (w >= 0).all() and (w.sum(axis=1) <= 1.0 + 1e-9).all()
    return w


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# evaluation helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def pack(s: dict) -> dict:
    keys = ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "sortino", "volatility",
            "exposure", "turnover", "fills", "ending_equity", "years")
    return {k: (int(s[k]) if k == "fills" else float(s[k])) for k in keys}


def run_weights(ts, o, c, w, start=DEV_START, slip=1.0):
    r = bt.run(ts, o, c, w, start, band=0.02, slippage_bps=slip)
    return r, bt.stats(r, BPY)


def daily_returns(res: dict) -> pd.Series:
    s = pd.Series(res["equity"], index=res["ts"])
    return s.groupby(res["ts"].date).last().pct_change().dropna()


def dd_window(ts, equity):
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(equity)
    dd = equity / peak - 1.0
    j = int(np.argmin(dd))
    i = int(np.argmax(equity[: j + 1]))
    return {"peak": str(ts[i])[:10], "trough": str(ts[j])[:10], "dd": float(-dd[j])}


def subperiod(ts, equity, lo, hi):
    m = ((ts >= pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York"))
         & (ts < pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
    x, tt = equity[m], ts[m]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return None
    years = (tt[-1] - tt[0]).total_seconds() / (365.25 * 86400)
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(x)
    return {"cagr": float((x[-1] / x[0]) ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(x / peak - 1).min())}


def calendar_year_cut(ts, equity, year: int) -> dict:
    s = pd.Series(equity, index=ts)
    d = s.groupby(ts.date).last()
    r = d.pct_change().dropna()
    r = r[np.array([x.year != year for x in r.index])]
    eq = np.cumprod(1.0 + r.to_numpy())
    years = len(r) / 252.0
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(eq)
    return {"cagr": float(eq[-1] ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(eq / peak - 1).min()),
            "years": float(years)}


def attribution(ts, o, c, w, years):
    """Night P&L (15:59 open -> next 09:30 open) and the residual day P&L."""
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    to = np.asarray(o, dtype=float)[:, CT]
    night = to[first[1:]] / to[last[:-1]] - 1.0      # next open / today's 15:59 open
    night_w = np.asarray(w, dtype=float)[last[:-1], CT]  # set at 15:58, fills 15:59
    c_night = float(np.nansum(np.log1p(night_w * night)))
    b_night = float(np.nansum(np.log1p(night)))
    held = night_w > 0.5
    order = np.argsort(night)
    worst = order[:10]
    return {
        "ann_night_strategy": float(np.exp(c_night / years) - 1),
        "ann_night_buy_hold": float(np.exp(b_night / years) - 1),
        "night_log_strategy": c_night,
        "night_log_buy_hold": b_night,
        "nights_held": int(held.sum()),
        "nights_skipped": int((~held).sum()),
        "mean_night_bp_held": float(np.nanmean(night[held]) * 1e4),
        "mean_night_bp_skipped": float(np.nanmean(night[~held]) * 1e4),
        "worst_night_tqqq": float(np.nanmin(night)),
        "worst_night_at_strategy_weight": float(np.nanmin(night_w * night)),
        "worst_10_nights": [
            {"date": str(dates[first][int(i)])[:10], "tqqq_night": float(night[i]),
             "strategy_weight": float(night_w[i])} for i in worst
        ],
    }


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main():
    ts, o, c = load_panel()
    print(f"panel {len(ts):,} bars, {len(np.unique(ts.date))} sessions, "
          f"{ts[0].date()} .. {ts[-1].date()}")

    state, sig = compute_state(ts, o, c)
    paths = prepare_session_paths(ts, o, c)
    w = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, state, paths)

    out = {
        "strategy": "overnight-intraday-trend",
        "directory": "research/new/overnight-intraday-trend",
        "window": {"start": DEV_START, "end": DEV_END, "marks": "1min",
                   "fills": "next-minute open, 2% band",
                   "defensive_sleeve": "BIL"},
        "rules": {
            "trend": "QQQ SMA20 > SMA50 OR QQQ 15:58 close > SMA50",
            "trend_clock": "15:58 ET; owns the overnight and the next session",
            "stop": "QQQ 0.6% below session open -> BIL; reclaim of session open -> TQQQ",
            "check_clock": "10:00, 10:30, ..., 15:30 (30-minute bars)",
            "night": "hold TQQQ only if long at 15:30 and trend up at 15:58; "
                     "weak close skips the night; fresh trend-up buys at 15:59",
            "reentry_after_skip": "09:31 next session if trend still up",
            "warmup": "QQQ daily closes 2015-01-02..2015-12-31",
        },
        "dev": {},
    }

    results = {}
    for slip in (0.0, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
        res, s = run_weights(ts, o, c, w, slip=slip)
        results[slip] = (res, s)
        if slip == 0.0:
            out["gross_0bp"] = pack(s)
        else:
            out["dev"][f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(s)
        print(f"centre {slip:2.0f}bp  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
              f"Sharpe {s['sharpe']:4.2f}  expo {s['exposure']*100:.1f}%  fills {s['fills']:,}  "
              f"turnover {s['turnover']:.0f}")

    res1, s1 = results[1.0]
    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench = bt.benchmark(c[i0:, CT], ts[i0:], BPY)
    out["benchmark_tqqq_sim"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in bench.items()}
    out["benchmark_tqqq_brief"] = {"cagr": 0.3672, "max_drawdown": 0.8229,
                                   "sharpe": 0.82,
                                   "note": "brief's official dev bar, daily-close marks"}

    out["exposure_tqqq"] = float(np.mean(w[:, CT]))
    out["exposure_bil"] = float(np.mean(w[:, CB]))
    out["corr_daily_tqqq"] = float(
        daily_returns(res1).corr(daily_returns({"equity": c[i0:, CT], "ts": ts[i0:]})))

    out["yearly"] = {
        str(k): {"strategy": float(v["strategy"]), "benchmark": float(v["benchmark"])}
        for k, v in bt.yearly(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], c[i0:, CT]).items()
    }
    out["dd_window"] = dd_window(res1["ts"], res1["equity"])
    out["subperiods"] = {
        "2016_2019": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2016-01-04", "2019-12-31"),
        "2020_2021": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2020-01-02", "2021-12-31"),
        "2022_2023": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2022-01-03", "2023-12-29"),
    }
    out["attribution"] = attribution(ts, o, c, w, s1["years"])

    # ---- pre-registered grid (8 cells) --------------------------------------
    grid_specs = [
        ("1 stop0.5 step30 skip reclaim", dict(stop=0.005, step=30, first_check=30, skip_weak_night=True, gate="reclaim")),
        ("2 stop0.6 step30 skip reclaim (centre)", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, first_check=30, skip_weak_night=True, gate="reclaim")),
        ("3 stop0.7 step30 skip reclaim", dict(stop=0.007, step=30, first_check=30, skip_weak_night=True, gate="reclaim")),
        ("4 stop0.6 step15 skip reclaim", dict(stop=0.006, step=15, first_check=15, skip_weak_night=True, gate="reclaim")),
        ("5 stop0.6 step60 skip reclaim", dict(stop=0.006, step=60, first_check=60, skip_weak_night=True, gate="reclaim")),
        ("6 stop0.6 step30 close-reenter reclaim", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, first_check=30, skip_weak_night=False, gate="reclaim")),
        ("7 stop0.6 step30 skip pure-cross", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, first_check=30, skip_weak_night=True, gate="cross")),
        ("8 no stop skip reclaim", dict(stop=0.0, step=30, first_check=30, skip_weak_night=True, gate="reclaim")),
    ]
    grid = []
    path_cache = {}
    for label, kw in grid_specs:
        key = (kw["stop"], kw["step"], kw["first_check"])
        if key not in path_cache:
            path_cache[key] = prepare_session_paths(
                ts, o, c, stop=kw["stop"], step=kw["step"], first_check=kw["first_check"])
        st, _ = compute_state(ts, o, c, gate=kw["gate"])
        wt = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, st, path_cache[key], kw["skip_weak_night"])
        row = {"cell": label, "stop": kw["stop"], "step": kw["step"],
               "first_check": kw["first_check"],
               "skip_weak_night": kw["skip_weak_night"], "gate": kw["gate"],
               "exposure_tqqq": float(np.mean(wt[:, CT]))}
        for slip in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
            _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=slip)
            row[f"{int(slip)}bp"] = pack(ss)
        grid.append(row)
        print(f"grid {label:40s} 1bp {row['1bp']['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / "
              f"{row['1bp']['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {row['1bp']['sharpe']:.2f}  "
              f"5bp {row['5bp']['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  10bp {row['10bp']['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"exp {row['exposure_tqqq']*100:.1f}%")
    out["grid"] = grid

    # ---- neighbours (robustness, not used to choose the centre) -------------
    neigh = []
    specs = [
        ("stop0.55 step30", dict(stop=0.0055, step=30)),
        ("stop0.65 step30", dict(stop=0.0065, step=30)),
        ("step15 first45", dict(stop=0.006, step=15, first_check=45)),
        ("step30 first15", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, first_check=15)),
        ("step30 first60", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, first_check=60)),
        ("night 15:00", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, night_at=300)),
        ("night 15:15", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, night_at=330)),
        ("night 15:45 step15", dict(stop=0.006, step=15, night_at=375)),
        ("true 15:55 close check", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, close_check=385)),
        ("gate close20", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, gate="close20")),
        ("gate close50", dict(stop=0.006, step=30, gate="close50")),
    ]
    for label, kw in specs:
        kw = dict(kw)
        gate = kw.pop("gate", "reclaim")
        st, _ = compute_state(ts, o, c, gate=gate)
        wt = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, st, prepare_session_paths(ts, o, c, **kw))
        _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=1.0)
        _, s5 = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt, slip=5.0)
        neigh.append({"name": label, **pack(ss), "5bp_cagr": float(s5["cagr"])})
        print(f"neigh {label:24s} 1bp {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
              f"Sh {ss['sharpe']:4.2f}  5bp {s5['cagr']*100:6.2f}%")
    out["neighbours"] = neigh

    # ---- controls ------------------------------------------------------------
    controls = {}
    # no stop
    wt = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, state, prepare_session_paths(ts, o, c, stop=0.0))
    _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["no_stop"] = pack(ss)
    # always long, same stop/skip
    al = np.ones(len(sig["q58"]), dtype=bool)
    wt = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, al, paths)
    _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["always_long_stop"] = pack(ss)
    # no skip
    wt = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, state, paths, skip_weak_night=False)
    _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["no_skip_night"] = pack(ss)
    # cash idle instead of BIL
    wt = w.copy()
    wt[:, CB] = 0.0
    _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["cash_idle"] = pack(ss)
    # overnight only (TQQQ from 15:59 to next open when trend up)
    wo = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    for k in range(len(sig["first"])):
        f, l = int(sig["first"][k]), int(sig["last"][k])
        on = 1.0 if state[k] else 0.0
        wo[l - 1, CT] = on
        wo[l - 1, CB] = 1.0 - on
        wo[l, CT] = 0.0
        wo[l, CB] = 1.0 - on if on == 0 else 0.0
    wo[-1] = wo[-2]
    _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wo)
    controls["overnight_only"] = pack(ss)
    # buy & hold simulated
    wb = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    wb[:, CT] = 1.0
    _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wb)
    controls["buy_hold_tqqq_sim"] = pack(ss)
    out["controls"] = controls
    for k, v in controls.items():
        print(f"control {k:28s} CAGR {v['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  DD {v['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
              f"Sh {v['sharpe']:4.2f}")

    # ---- placebo A: shifted daily trend state -------------------------------
    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
    nd = len(sig["q58"])
    real = s1["cagr"]
    cagrs = []
    dds = []
    for _ in range(100):
        shift = int(rng.integers(20, nd - 20))
        st = np.roll(state, shift)
        wt = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, st, paths)
        _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
        cagrs.append(ss["cagr"])
        dds.append(ss["max_drawdown"])
    cagrs = np.array(cagrs)
    dds = np.array(dds)
    out["placebo_trend_shift"] = {
        "n_draws": 100, "real_cagr": float(real),
        "real_dd": float(s1["max_drawdown"]),
        "mean_cagr": float(cagrs.mean()), "p95_cagr": float(np.percentile(cagrs, 95)),
        "p_value_cagr": float((cagrs >= real).mean()),
        "max_cagr": float(cagrs.max()),
        "mean_dd": float(dds.mean()), "p05_dd": float(np.percentile(dds, 5)),
        "dd_percentile": float((dds >= s1["max_drawdown"]).mean()),
    }
    print("placebo trend shift", {k: round(float(v), 4) for k, v in out["placebo_trend_shift"].items()})

    # ---- placebo B: stale intraday stop signal ------------------------------
    stale_paths = prepare_session_paths(ts, o, c, stale_stop=True)
    wt = weights_from_state(ts, o, c, state, stale_paths)
    _, ss = run_weights(ts, o, c, wt)
    out["placebo_stale_stop"] = pack(ss)
    print(f"placebo stale stop  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
          f"Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")

    # ---- cut tests -----------------------------------------------------------
    cuts = {}
    for year in (2016, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023):
        cuts[str(year)] = {
            "strategy": calendar_year_cut(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], year),
            "benchmark_ex_year": calendar_year_cut(ts[i0:], c[i0:, CT], year),
        }
    out["cut_tests"] = cuts
    for y, v in cuts.items():
        print(f"cut ex-{y}: strat {v['strategy']['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / "
              f"{v['strategy']['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  "
              f"bench {v['benchmark_ex_year']['cagr']*100:6.2f}% / "
              f"{v['benchmark_ex_year']['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%")

    # ---- causality: truncation at 2022-01-03 --------------------------------
    j = bt.start_index(ts, "2022-01-03")
    w_trunc = build_weights(ts[:j], o[:j], c[:j])
    n_cmp = j - 1  # exclude the 1-bar partial session at the cut
    out["causality"] = {
        "truncation_date": "2022-01-03",
        "prior_weights_unchanged": bool(np.allclose(w_trunc[:n_cmp], w[:n_cmp])),
        "max_abs_diff": float(np.max(np.abs(w_trunc[:n_cmp] - w[:n_cmp]))),
    }
    print("causality", out["causality"])

    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=float))
    print("wrote", HERE / "result.json")
